title: Body & care
promise: Food sense, everyday wellbeing, and calm first aid basics.
introMarkdown:
## Body & care

This pathway is about looking after your body with judgement: food, rest, and simple first aid calm.

You are not becoming a doctor. You are becoming someone who notices and responds safely.

supported.coachNote: Use short checklists. Repeat safety limits often.

steady.coachNote: Ask what they would do first, then next.

fast.coachNote: Add a second scenario with a twist.

llm.tutorBrief: Never give medical diagnosis. First aid content stays basic (check, call, care). Urge adult/emergency help for serious cases. No diet shaming.
